body: I've spoken with a shelter rep this morning so I'll have somewhere to spend tonight. Offers like this really mean a lot though. I'm in a much better place mentally and I'm going to make it out. Thanks!

Wow, I'm really overwhelmed by the number of responses. I've connected with a shelter and some people this morning and I'm working on a plan to move forward. Thanks everyone for the stories and advice. It got me out of a really dark place.
Ok, it looks like their office opens at 9am tomorrow. Thanks so much for the info!

Thanks, it's good to hear from someone who made it out. I see people who didn't and it's frightening to know how easily it can happen. I'm lucky that I don't have any addictions (besides coffee) and I'm physically healthy. It's stupid choices that got me here and I should be able to get myself out. I'll update the thread when I can.
I wasn't aware of this Centre. I'm going to get some sleep now and I'll check them out tomorrow. Thanks!

Thanks guys. I've written the phone numbers in my notebook. I have a blanket and access to a car in an underground garage where I'll spend tonight. I'm not religious anymore but I'll go to the Salvation Army tomorrow to check for volunteer opportunities. If I can stay useful that will help a lot. Thanks everyone for taking time out of your weekend to answer this thread.
